project: ComplyFlow — Compliance Workflow & Process Intelligence Platform

botDefinition.description: AI-assisted compliance operations assistant providing case summarization, SLA tracking, and audit log analysis.

capabilities.name: Natural Language KPI Questions
capabilities.description: Conversational retrieval of core operational metrics from governed SQL views and Power BI DAX measures

capabilities.name: Case Summarization
capabilities.description: Rapid synthesis of compliance request fields, risk tiers, and outstanding actions

capabilities.name: Audit History Explanation
capabilities.description: Chronological narrative reconstruction of sequential case audit milestones

capabilities.name: SLA Policy Explanation
capabilities.description: Plain-language explanation of regulatory turnaround targets, warning thresholds, and escalation pathways

capabilities.name: Operational Insight Generation
capabilities.description: Factual, descriptive observations of queue volume distribution and cycle times

capabilities.name: Process Improvement Assistance
capabilities.description: Exploratory hypotheses regarding workflow bottlenecks and approval dwell times

topics.name: Topic_KPI_Query
triggerPhrases: How many active cases do we have?
What is the historical SLA breach rate?
What is our average resolution time?

topics.name: Topic_SLA_Policy
triggerPhrases: What is the SLA for Critical?
What is the SLA for High?
